## Plain text in, slides out

Each `##` heading starts a new slide.

```markdown
## A live sketch

<iframe data-src="embeds/p5-ripples.html"></iframe>
```

Use the arrow keys to move on.

## A live sketch (p5.js)

<iframe data-src="embeds/p5-ripples.html" title="p5.js ripples" style="width:100%;height:470px;border:0;border-radius:10px"></iframe>

Move the mouse over it.

## ...and 3D (three.js)

<iframe data-src="embeds/three-knot.html" title="three.js knot" style="width:100%;height:470px;border:0;border-radius:10px"></iframe>

Drag it, or change the twists.

## One source, many outputs

The same kind of file can also become a web page, a PDF or a Word document.

That is the whole idea.
